data.body: Fixed: Added os.fsync() to _state_set_field and _state_init python writes in merge-helpers.sh to ensure data is flushed to disk before mv rename; wrapped file ops in try/except for cleaner error propagation. Also added a 3-retry polling loop (100ms interval) in test_sigurg_records_interrupted_phase to guard against rare OS page-cache flush delays on loaded CI runners. Files changed: plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh, tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh
